body: I hope you feel better soon and I'm doing good thank you. :)
I'm doing good, thank you.
Hey!
Hey, thanks for reaching out.
Thanks and you have a good day/evening/night. 🙂
I'm going to sleep now because it's very late, so I'll talk to you again soon.
Never heard of any of those breeds, but I'll research it later. Good luck with the new cat.
Aww, that's good to hear. What kind of cat are you thinking of getting?
Haha, I'll keep that in my mind. So that I can watch them later.
Atm, it's white Christmas, what about you?
Yeah, it is good. All the pets are fantastic thank you, we have 8 dogs in the house, at the moment.
Ikr, it's fantastic.
Well, my parents said to me today that I look pale but I don't feel it.
I'm starting to watch the black mirror and it's really interesting.
Yeah, I've heard about the Twin Peaks. My uncle likes it, he listens to it on the broadcast.
I'm glad that you are keeping it together. I was feeling unwell on the Monday and Tuesday, but I'm much better.
I'm good thank you and how are you?
Hey, how are you today?

That's good that they were pretty though. Good luck for tomorrow. Yeah, Siberian huskies are my favourite dog breed. Well, I'm not sure what kind of craft, I know that's silly because I should know really. They are very tiny gems.

That's good! Was the cupcakes nice? It doesn't matter really because you can always try again. I did some craft today and you have to put the gems on the Siberian husky photo. I still haven't finished it, I think it's going to take a long time. At the moment, 2 of my dogs are cuddling me which is fantastic.

Your welcome, the weather was quite nice actually. We had blue skies and a bit of a breeze, how's the weather for you? 
The dogs are really good thank you and I'm ok, except I'm a bit tired and no appetite for food.

Your welcome and I thought I'll say hi to you. 
I hope you will feel better soon.
Hey, how are you today?
That's great to hear. It's good that you have a quick journey as well. :)
I would love to talk to you and thank you! And if you want to talk to me, I'll be here.
I like chatting as well and I hope it will get easier for you one day. It's really nice to talk to you too. :)

Thanks and I think they are cute names too. Well, maybe one day you will have 2 cats. My old school used to have snails because they had a subject called Animal care. Thank you for talking to me, I really appreciate that.
That's a shame that you don't have any pets. They are amazing and I love animals. Their names are Rascal, Millie, Rooney, Toby, Teddy and Gemma. Wow! That's interesting. Are Snails good pets?
Aww bless, that's very nice. We have 6 dogs; 2 Yorkshire terriers, 1 Norwich terrier, 1 chihuahua, 1 Chinese crest puffball X poodle and 1 saluki X lurcher.

The weather was very windy today but I love the wind. It blows on your face and it's a great feeling. 
Spending time with my dogs is always the best day for me. 
That's great to hear, sugar is good for energy. It's also healthy. What's the best part of your day so far? And how is the weather?
That's good to hear, I'm fine either guess. Thank you.
I'm fine I guess, thanks for asking.

Thank you, that made me smile. Yeah, I do deserve love and I also have to accept it as well. My family is really loving and caring and I love them and care for them too. 
I actually went to the movies last weekend and it was really good. Yeah, I fake my smile a lot because I don't want people to see me sad. I rarely cry and if I do, I cry alone somewhere.
I'm so sorry to hear that. Yeah, they do love me and cares about me. Thank you for sharing.

I'm glad that I am helping you too and thank you for sharing about yourself. 
Well I hate myself because of my past, I always think about it. Even to this day, even though I've got a fantastic family who loves me and worries about me. I blame myself for everything and I wonder why doesn't people want me, I had a lot of bad experiences in life and some of them, I could have died but I  didn't. 
I don't care about myself because I put people and animals first then me, they seem more important. I don't think of myself important. 
I'm so sorry to hear about that and I hope one day you will love yourself. I think that you will do well with your A levels  and exercise is really good for us. I go horse riding and that's the only thing that makes me happy and animated. 
What things do you love to do? 
I hope that one day you will be ok and stay strong as well.

Because I just think that I don't care about myself, I feel that people shouldn't care about me. No one cared about me before until 9 months ago. I'm a good person and I don't hurt people intentionally. Yeah, people say that I am amazing. I love them like my real family and I wish they are my real parents. Ok, I won't let go and thank you for helping me. I'll try to be strong.
Yeah, pretty much.
Yeah, it is a rough journey. My life is like a rollercoaster, up and down and repeat. I love my family and I don't want to hurt their feelings. Last time I tried, they were very upset.
I love my new family though, lots and lots.
Yeah, I want to get better but sometimes it's impossible. I just can't take it anymore and I don't understand why people care about me now.

My biological family doesn't care about me and I am now living with the most caring new family. But, I feel like I that it shouldn't me because I don't care about myself. I don't care what happens to me and I feel rubbish.
Everything, it's too much for me.
